concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-donation-campaigns]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen Giving reporting guide for campaign-dashboard latency, Customer Area roles, per-donation Processed versus grouped nonprofit Received report grain, and currency/time-zone/column qualifications; report descriptions are not bank-receipt proof.
warnings: Use the exact report and account scope: Processed entries are individual donations, while Received entries summarize donations by attributes and are nonprofit-only; both reports are company-account-only.
The guide describes donations as settled or paid out in report text; do not infer bank arrival, transaction-specific finality, or correct accounting treatment from a dashboard or report row alone.

Keep original-donation gross currency and settlement net currency, donation PSP reference and triggering commercial-payment PSP reference, AMS/CET and merchant-local dates, and dashboard latency distinct.

This donation guide's blanket no-other-payment-information sentence conflicts with the separate User roles reference for Merchant financial. Its broader financial permissions must be checked before assigning it; the narrow no-payment-information statement in User roles applies to Donation campaigns viewer and manager.
